# Documentation

- [Overview](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs.md): Unofficial, community-maintained Linux KDE Kirigami desktop application for inspecting and updating PlayStation DualSense firmware over USB HID.
- [Getting Started & Installation](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/getting-started.md): Download the Linux AppImage or build dualsense-updater from source with Rust, Qt 6, and KDE Kirigami.
- [Supported Hardware & Board Revisions](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/supported-hardware.md): DualSense and DualSense Edge USB IDs, BDM board revision decoding, Sony firmware targets, and colorway detection.
- [Safety, USB Permissions & Troubleshooting](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/safety-and-troubleshooting.md): Firmware update irreversibility, Linux udev rules for /dev/hidraw access, and common recovery guidance.
- [Changelog](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/changelog.md): Release history and notable changes for Unofficial Linux DualSense Firmware Updater.
- [Licenses & Acknowledgments](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/licenses.md): GPL-3.0-or-later license, original author attribution to nchie (MIT), and third-party open-source software credits.
